title: A Clinical Trial of Dermacorder for Detecting Malignant Skin Lesions
brief_summary: The Dermacorder measures the electric field in the skin. Malignant skin lesions disrupt the skin's normal electric field and this abnormal electric field can be detected by the Dermacorder. Therefore the investigators are testing the hypothesis that the Dermacorder can provide useful data to guide in the diagnosis of skin disease.
study_population: Males and females with multiple basal cell carcinomas
